To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $1,000$, and the percentage is $9%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
9%=9÷100=0.09
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =9%\times 1,000 \\  & =0.09\times 1,000 \\  & =90\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $9%$ of $1,000$ is $90.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
9%=\frac{9}{100}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =9%\times 1,000 \\  & =\frac{9}{100}\times 1,000 \\  & =9\times \frac{1,000}{100} \\  & =9\times 10 \\  & =90\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $9%$ of $1,000$ is $90.$
